﻿CLIPFARM x FIRST PRESS CAMPAIGN BRIEF
	

First Press is a business podcast by Press On Ventures. It shows how brands get built. Clip the provided episodes. You earn money for every view.
CPM
$1.50 / 1K
	MAX PER CLIP
$350
	MIN PAYOUT
$1.50 / 1.0K
	

READ THIS FIRST — DON'T SKIP
Your clip must teach one clear idea. It must look clean and professional.
This is a business show. No memes. No drama. No clickbait.
	

QUICK FACTS
Client
	First Press (a Press On Ventures podcast)
	Page Type
	Business, startup, or podcast clip pages
	Content
	Short, clean podcast clips that teach
	Platforms
	TikTok · Instagram Reels · YouTube Shorts
	Tagging
	TikTok: @firstpress_povc
YouTube: @firstpress-povc
IG: @pressonventures
	Caption
	Your own words/clip recap relevant to clip + tag + “Full Episode on First Press by Press on Ventures YT”
No #ad needed
	Audience
	40%+ of views from US · UK · Canada · Australia
	

✔  Think: a smart business clip. One idea. Clean edit. Easy to follow.
	

❌  NOT the point: Meme edits. Loud sound effects. Clickbait text. Clips with no clear point.
	

WHAT TO DO
It is easy. Just follow these steps:
* Get our clips from the folder below.
* Make a short video using ONLY the provided footage.
* Add what is REQUIRED and post.
* Submit your video on Whop.
* When your stats load, open a ticket in Whop or Discord for approval.
* Not sure how to submit? See the How To Submit Clips section.


✔  The guest shares real lessons. Your job is to clip the best one.
	

WHERE TO GET THE CLIPS
Use ONLY the files from this link:
* DOWNLOAD FOOTAGE


⚠  Do NOT use any clip from outside this link. Outside clips get rejected right away.
	

WHERE TO POST
Post on these platforms.
1.  TikTok
2.  Instagram Reels
3.  YouTube Shorts
TAG THE CLIENT  (REQUIRED)
Tag the client in your caption. Tag the right handle for each app.
TikTok
	@firstpress_povc
	YouTube Shorts
	@firstpress-povc
	Instagram Reels
	 @pressonventures
	YOUR CAPTION  (REQUIRED)
Write your own relevant to clip / recap. Keep it short and clear. English ONLY.
Say what the clip teaches.
It must send them to the channel by saying: “Full Episode on First Press by Press on Ventures YT”
No hype. No clickbait.


YOUR AUDIENCE  (REQUIRED)
At least 40% of your views must come from: US, UK, Canada, Australia.
	

HOW TO SUBMIT  (REQUIRED)
* Post your video.
* Copy the post link.
* Submit it on Whop.
* Submit your video demographics when the clip hits min payout.
* Wait for approval. Then you get paid.
THE RULES
✅  YOU MUST
	❌  YOU WILL NOT GET PAID IF
	Post to: TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts
	Clips from outside the official link
	Keep your post up at least 30 days
	NSFW, violent, or off-topic videos
	Likes are visible (hidden likes = rejected)
	Spam (same video on many pages)
	At least 0.20% engagement
	Paid ads or "boost / promote" tools — no fake views, no bots
	40%+ audience from US, UK, CA, AUS
	Bait posting (random viral clips to farm views)
	Submit video demographics
	Stealing / reposting somebody else's content
	Tell them to watch the full episode “Watch The Full Episode on First Press by Press on Ventures YT Channel”
	Clickbait, memes, or silly edits
	Keep it clean, professional, and helpful
	Swearing or rude text
